stem.text: The statements refer to vaccination programmes for each of the diseases cholera, measles, smallpox and tuberculosis (TB).
Which statement is correct for TB?

A.text: Most children are vaccinated before their first birthday.

B.text: The pathogen has not mutated or changed its antigens.

C.text: The pathogen lives in the intestine where antibodies cannot get to it.

D.text: The vaccine is not effective against some strains of the pathogen.
